title: agentic wizard (plan 11 J9b)
objective: The agentic wizard (v2.6 plan 11) takes one premise to a saved, valid story: plan, one tool call per step, every write reviewed (the runner accepts draft edits and confirms each provisioning card on its own), diagnostics fed back, the author's Save. Every asset it creates is recorded in the SO-J9b session ledger and deleted in cleanup; a leak is a gate failure. Runs in the plan 10 final suite (x2); x1 in plan 11 once a lane is free. The agent runs through the Studio's own runner (createAgentRunner over resolveAgentHarness, driven by driveAgent), so a Wizard role routed to harness:opencode:<model> takes the native tool bridge here exactly as in the UI; J14.2 then requires open, tool call, answer and close evidence from that bridge.

checks.goal: one premise becomes a finished, valid story through the agent's tools alone, and the author's Save puts it in the library

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const agent = globalThis.storyOrchestratorWizardAgent; const store = globalThis.storyOrchestratorStudioDraft; if (!agent || !rt.model) throw new Error('needs the dev bundle: storyOrchestratorWizardAgent and storyOrchestratorRuntime.model'); for (const name of ['createAgentRunner', 'driveAgent', 'resolveAgentHarness']) if (typeof agent[name] !== 'function') throw new Error(`storyOrchestratorWizardAgent lacks ${name}: the journey drives the Studio's own runner and bridge resolver; rebuild the dev bundle`); const bridge = { transport: 'none', refusal: null, events: [] }; const recording = (inner) => ({ open: async (request) => { const result = await inner.open(request); bridge.events.push({ op: 'open', ok: Boolean(result?.ok), sessionId: result?.ok ? result.sessionId : null, kind: result?.ok ? null : result?.kind ?? null }); return result; }, nextCall: async (sessionId, deadlineAt) => { const event = await inner.nextCall(sessionId, deadlineAt); bridge.events.push({ op: 'next', sessionId, kind: event?.kind ?? null, tool: event?.kind === 'call' ? event.tool : null, callId: event?.callId ?? null }); return event; }, answer: async (sessionId, callId, answer) => { const delivered = await inner.answer(sessionId, callId, answer); bridge.events.push({ op: 'answer', sessionId, callId, delivered: Boolean(delivered) }); return delivered; }, close: async (sessionId) => { const closed = await inner.close(sessionId); bridge.events.push({ op: 'close', sessionId }); return closed; } }); const harness = async () => { const transport = await agent.resolveAgentHarness(); if (!transport) { bridge.transport = 'none'; return null; } if (transport.refusal) { bridge.transport = 'refusal'; bridge.refusal = String(transport.refusal); return transport; } bridge.transport = transport.bridge ? 'bridge' : 'text'; return transport.bridge ? { ...transport, bridge: recording(transport.bridge) } : transport; }; const runner = agent.createAgentRunner({ model: rt.model, environment: (draft) => rt.getProvisioningEnvironment(draft), harness }); const ownership = { mint: () => ({}), check: () => ({ ok: true }) }; let session = agent.newAgentSession("A courier must cross a flooded city before the tide turns, carrying a parcel two rival guilds both want. Name every card, lorebook and group you create with the prefix SO-J9b.", 'review', { maxSteps: 40 }); const kept = []; const apply = (op) => { kept.push(op.kind); store.getState().mutate((draft) => agent.applyDraftOp(draft, op)); }; for (let guard = 0; guard < 120; guard += 1) { if (session.status === 'awaiting-plan') { session = agent.approvePlan(session, session.plan); continue; } if (session.status === 'awaiting-author') { const pending = agent.pendingStep(session); if (pending.family === 'provision') { const outcome = await rt.applyProvisioning(pending.op, store.getState().draft); if (outcome.ok) store.getState().mutate((draft) => agent.applyProvisioningFollowUps(draft, pending.op)); session = agent.resolveProvisioning(session, pending.id, outcome, store.getState().draft); continue; } const decided = agent.decideStep(session, pending.id, { kind: 'accept' }, store.getState().draft); session = decided.session; if (decided.apply) apply(decided.apply); continue; } if (session.status !== 'planning' && session.status !== 'running') break; const outcome = await agent.driveAgent(session, { runner, ownership, draft: () => store.getState().draft, applyOp: apply, commit: (next) => { session = next; }, stopRequested: () => false }); session = outcome.session; if (outcome.lapsed) throw new Error(`the drive lapsed: ${outcome.lapsed}`); } store.getState().mutate((draft) => ({ ...draft, title: "SO-J9b Agent draft" })); const errors = agent.validationErrorCount(store.getState().draft); const opened = bridge.events.filter((event) => event.op === 'open' && event.ok); const calls = bridge.events.filter((event) => event.op === 'next' && event.kind === 'call'); const answered = bridge.events.filter((event) => event.op === 'answer' && event.delivered); const unclosed = opened.filter((open) => !bridge.events.some((event) => event.sessionId === open.sessionId && (event.op === 'close' || (event.op === 'next' && (event.kind === 'done' || event.kind === 'ended'))))); const evidence = { opened: opened.length, calls: calls.length, answered: answered.length, unanswered: calls.filter((call) => !bridge.events.some((event) => event.op === 'answer' && event.callId === call.callId)).map((call) => call.callId), unclosed: unclosed.map((open) => open.sessionId) }; globalThis.__soJ9bAgent = { status: session.status, steps: session.steps.length, stats: agent.agentStats(session), errors, kept, bridge, evidence }; if (bridge.transport === 'refusal') throw new Error(`the Studio resolver refused the harness route: ${bridge.refusal}`); if (bridge.transport === 'bridge' && (!evidence.opened || !evidence.calls || !evidence.answered || evidence.unanswered.length || evidence.unclosed.length)) throw new Error(`routed to the native tool bridge, but its evidence is incomplete: ${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`); if (session.status !== 'done') throw new Error(`the agent did not finish its plan: ${session.status} after ${session.steps.length} step(s)`); if (errors) throw new Error(`the finished story has ${errors} validation error(s)`); return globalThis.__soJ9bAgent;
const r = globalThis.__soJ9bAgent; if (!r || r.stats.accepted < 1) throw new Error('the agent kept no change'); return r;

checks.goal: with "Wizard and road ahead" routed to harness:opencode:<model>, J14.1 ran over the native tool bridge: a session opened, native tool calls reached the page, each was answered over the bridge, and every session closed (blocked when the role is not routed to a bridge-offering harness)

steps.eval: const r = globalThis.__soJ9bAgent; if (!r) throw new Error('J14.2 reads the bridge record J14.1 leaves: run the whole journey'); if (r.bridge.transport !== 'bridge') throw new Error(`the authoring role did not take the native bridge (transport ${r.bridge.transport})`); const e = r.evidence; if (!e.opened || !e.calls || !e.answered || e.unanswered.length || e.unclosed.length) throw new Error(`incomplete bridge evidence: ${JSON.stringify(e)}`); return { transport: r.bridge.transport, evidence: e, tools: r.bridge.events.filter((event) => event.op === 'next' && event.kind === 'call').map((event) => event.tool) };
